description: Inspect a public HTTPS URL for a fresh x402 v2 HTTP 402 challenge using an unsigned GET with a 10-second network timeout and no redirect following. Returns validated payTo, asset, network, atomic amount, resource and maxTimeoutSeconds; incomplete or non-x402 responses return challenge=null and a reason. Does not sign, settle or verify receipts. Fresh requirements override documented receiver hints; inspect canonical_receiver_match before choosing to pay.

url.description: Full public HTTPS URL to inspect with an unsigned GET. No payment headers; redirects, credentials and private network targets are rejected.

name: check_payment

asset.description: Asset identifier from the fresh requirements; never replaced with a cached symbol.

resource.description: Exact resource URL or identifier advertised by the endpoint.

scheme.description: Payment scheme advertised by the fresh requirement.

canonical_receiver_match.description: Comparison with documented SML receiver; a mismatch never rewrites upstream requirements.

challenge.description: Fresh validated requirements, or null. No synthetic defaults are inserted.

asset.description: Asset identifier from the fresh requirements; never replaced with a cached symbol.

resource.description: Exact resource URL or identifier advertised by the endpoint.

scheme.description: Payment scheme advertised by the fresh requirement.

http_status.description: Observed HTTP status; zero means no HTTP response was received.

is_x402.description: True only for HTTP 402 with complete validated x402 v2 requirements.

raw_headers.description: Allowlisted response headers only; never cookies or authentication headers.

title: Check Payment
